s.g: The name of the Latin script letter K/k.
A wise and trusted counselor or teacher.
A male member of a monastic order who has devoted his life for religious service.
Of an object, outdated or no longer in vogue.
Of a person, preferring the customs of earlier times and the old-style ways.
(Christianity, loosely) Of or pertaining to a particular Orthodox Church, usually the Eastern Orthodox Church, sometimes the Oriental Orthodox Church or the Church of the East.
Adhering to whatever is customary, traditional, or generally accepted. [1640s]
Located above, especially over the head.
The expense of a business not directly assigned to goods or services provided.
Above one's head; in the sky.
Kicked over one's own head.
Wasted money.
An artist who paints pictures.
A laborer or workman who paints surfaces using a paintbrush or other means.
To create a hole in the skin for the purpose of inserting jewelry.
The operator of a printing press or the owner of a printing business; (metonymic) any printing business.
A device, usually attached to a computer, used to print text or images onto paper; an analogous device capable of producing three-dimensional objects.
Having a downward inclination or slope.
(figuratively) Predisposed, liable, inclined.
A planned event at which members of a dispersed group meet together.
A place of safety, refuge, or protection.
(religion) The supreme evil spirit in the Abrahamic religions, who tempts humanity into sin; the Devil; (Theistic Satanism) the same figure, regarded as a deity to be revered and worshipped.
The capital city of South Korea, also the historical capital of Korea from 1394 until the country was divided in 1945.
The cardinal number occurring after fifty-nine and before sixty-one, represented in Roman numerals as LX and in Arabic numerals as 60.
The ordinal form of the number sixty-one, describing a person or thing in position number 61 of a sequence.
The cardinal number immediately following sixty and preceding sixty-two.
The cardinal number immediately following sixty-one and preceding sixty-three.
The part of a garment that covers the arm.
Of or relating to sound.
A series of bones situated at the back from the head to the pelvis of a human, or from the head to the tail of an animal, enclosing the spinal cord and providing support for the thorax and abdomen.
A pointed, fairly rigid protuberance or needlelike structure on an animal, shell, mushroom or plant. The botanical term technically refers to such a structure derived from a leaf or part of a leaf.
Equipment used to control direction; something used to steer.
A status of possessing a thing or an office; an incumbency.
A status of having a permanent post with enhanced job security within an academic institution.
A period of time during which something is possessed.
The feel or shape of a surface or substance; the smoothness, roughness, softness, etc. of something.
(arts) The quality given to a work of art by the composition and interaction of its parts.
Senses relating to the change of information, etc., from one form to another.
The government official in charge of the Treasury.
A polygon with three sides and three angles.
A country in South America. Official name: Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. Capital and largest city: Caracas.
A port city and comune, the capital of the Metropolitan City of Venice and the region of Veneto, Italy; former capital of an independent republic.
A en given name, but rare as a name of English-speaking persons.
One who is especially skilled or unusually talented in a particular field.
Fully occupied with one's thoughts; engrossed. [First attested in the mid 18th century.]
An emotion; a feeling or natural impulse acting upon and swaying the mind.
A feeling of love or strong attachment; a feeling of enjoyable and comforting fondness.
The length of such a line; the distance measured perpendicularly from a figure's vertex to the side opposite to the vertex.
Height.
The capital city of Greece.
That has been cooked by baking.
Of or relating to the Bible.
A loud exclamation intended to scare someone. Usually used when one has been hidden from the target, and then appears unexpectedly.
An exclamation used by a member of an audience, as at a stage play or sporting event, to indicate derision or disapproval.
Slash and burn (technique in agriculture where plant matter is roughly cut down and then burned over to prepare fields for the next crop)
A city and county, the capital and largest city of Wales.
An area located outside of towns and cities; an area that is not urban or suburban; a rural area.
Any bird of the family Gruidae, large birds with long legs and a long neck which is extended during flight.
A mechanical lifting machine or device, often used for lifting heavy loads for industrial or construction purposes.
Having both eyes oriented inward, especially involuntarily.
Rubble, wreckage, scattered remains of something destroyed.

Bir grubu ya da kurumu temsilen görevlendirilen kişiler topluluğu.
An act of delegating.
One who makes a donation.
To instruct or train.
The act of enrolling or the state of being enrolled.
(transitive) To be larger, greater than (something).
The ordinal form of the number forty-seven, describing a person or thing in position number 47 of a sequence.
An archangel associated in Judaism, Christianity and Islam, with carrying messages from God.
A plant, Allium sativum, related to the onion, having a pungent bulb much used in cooking.
